## Notes

```text
Table spec 1.0: the 22 tables of ClinVar-GKM's 1.1.0 latest Parquet set (design plan §3).
Format: see src/clinvar_gkm_parquet/spec.py. Rules: .claude/rules/table-spec.md. Rendered: README.md (generated
by scripts/render-spec-readme.py; don't edit it by hand).

status: draft. Names, order and types are taken from ClinVar-GKM's BigQuery export SQL, its 1.1.0 column
reference (the "Full nested types" DESCRIBE blocks) and the procedures that build the gkm_dict_* tables that the
struct tables copy with `SELECT t.*`, ahead of the first 1.1.0 export. Spec 1.0 is final only once it is
captured from that export (scripts/capture-spec.py: DESCRIBE of all 22 files and a scan of every extensions
column, design plan §3.2), when status becomes "captured". It is "released" with the tool release that first
writes it; after that it is never edited. Columns marked `# unconfirmed:` could not be pinned from a 1.1.0 source.

Checked 2026-10-22 against the published 1.1.0 export (v1/1.1/parquet/, BigQuery export of
clinvar_2026_10_18_v2_6_0, read from the Parquet footers only): column names, order and full nested types are
identical for all 22 tables. Still to capture from the export: the extension slot map (which names occur,
filling which slot) and the empty-versus-NULL rules, which need a scan of the data, not just the footers.

Rules that hold for every table (design plan §3.4, §3.5):
- `data` (therapy/therapyGroup: `value`) is the bundle record, byte for byte as on its bundle line.
- Pointers: every bare-id / pointer-section column, and every pointer position a typed copy strips, must hold a
  '#/<section>/<id>' string; anything else stops the build.
- Typed copies: an object may hold only the fields of its spec struct (else the build stops); inside a typed
  value an absent struct or scalar is NULL and an absent list is [] (BigQuery stores no NULL arrays). A struct
  with `name` and `value_*` fields is an extension: the bundle's {name, value} goes into the slot that
  `extension_slots` names; an unlisted name stops the build. Slots other than the named one are NULL ([] for a
  list slot). The []-for-nested-lists rule follows BigQuery's REPEATED semantics and is confirmed by the oracle.
- Tables whose columns copy the whole record (BigQuery `SELECT t.*`) stop on a top-level record field that no
  column covers.
```
